name: size
label: Size
description: Sets the size of the text area component, either small (sm) or medium (md)

name: color
label: Color
description: Sets the background color of the text area

name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: Disables the text area. The text area appears grayed out and cannot be modified by the user

name: readonly
label: Read-only
description: When true, the text area is enabled, but the user cannot modify its contents

name: autofocus
label: Auto-focus
description: When true, focus is automatically placed inside the text area on page load

name: label
label: Label
description: String that describes the overall purpose of the text area field

name: wrapLabel
label: Wrap label
description: Wraps the label if it does not fit on one line

name: value
label: Value
description: Content of the text area

name: manageValue
label: Manage value
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the value property. Use the value set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder text
description: Hint text to display in the text area before text has been input

name: rows
label: Height rows
description: Height of the text area, in characters

name: cols
label: Width columns
description: Width of the text area, in characters

name: maxlength
label: Max. characters
description: Maximum number of characters that a user can enter in the text area

name: minlength
label: Min. characters
description: Minimum number of characters that a user must enter in the text area

name: helperContent
label: Helper text
description: When defined, an iconic button with popover appears next to the text area label for displaying additional hint text to the user, such as password requirements or other instructions for completing the field. Use plain text so the text is translatable. If you do not want to add helper content, leave this property empty

name: messages
label: Alert messages
description: Array of inline alert messages that display below the text area

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: When true, the text area appears visually invalid, indicating incorrect input

name: manageInvalid
label: Manage invalid
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the invalid property. Use the invalid set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: required
label: Required
description: When true, a user must enter a value in the text area before they can complete the form

name: hideRequiredIndicator
label: Hide required indicator
description: When true, the required indicator is visually hidden. Use this for forms where most fields are required. Then use the `optional` flag for any fields that are not required

name: optional
label: Optional
description: When true, entering data in the text area is optional and does not need to be completed by the user before completing the form

name: autoresize
label: Auto-resize
description: When true, the text area height automatically increases as the user types in the text area

name: autoresizeRowsLimit
label: Autoresize rows limit
description: Max number of rows when Autoresize is true

name: resize
label: Resize
description: Defines whether a user can resize the text area vertically, horizontally, in both directions, or neither direction

name: disableMinHeight
label: Disable min height
description: When true, the default minimum height of 64px is ignored. Use with rows={1} to create a single-line text area

name: disableMaxHeight
label: Disable max height
description: When true, the default maximum height of 256px is ignored

name: showCounter
label: Show character counter
description: Indicates whether to display a character counter beneath the text area to show the user the number of remaining characters

name: name
label: Identifier
description: Reference name for the text area control. This name is dispatched along with the text area value on user interaction

name: configAria
label: ARIA properties
description: Configures ARIA properties

name: fieldLayout
label: Field layout configuration
description: Configuration for the field layout. Determines whether the labels, field and slotted content are arranged vertically or horizontally, and their respective proportion in a horizontal container

name: landmark
label: Landmark
description: Allow the Landmark Focus keyboard shortcut to focus this textarea

name: enableCaretSlot
label: Enable caret slot
description: When true, a slot will be added to the component that follows the user's text cursor
